purpose: test whether the verifier is stable enough to be worth calibrating, before spending human labels
design: stratified subset of 64 judged element pairs, 4 per task-condition cell, fixed seed 20260902; each pair re-judged by the same judge with the same prompt and independently judged by a second model
reading: a single verdict flips on rerun in about one case in six, so single-call verdicts are noisy
cross-model agreement is only moderate once chance is removed
both agreements rise sharply above 0.9 confidence and no high-confidence pair disagreed across models, which is the separation the abstention design assumes
agreement is reliability, not accuracy, so none of this establishes that the verdicts are correct

calibration_set.shortfall_reason: the low-confidence stratum contained only 2 eligible pairs in the retained population

claim_scope: instrument reliability only; no validity and no treatment effect
